summary.en: Platform for sharing and deploying open-source AI models with large community.
summary.zh: 分享和部署开源 AI 模型的平台，拥有庞大的社区。

title.en: Hugging Face API Key - Open Source Model Platform | Get Model Key
title.zh: Hugging Face API Key - 开源模型平台 | Get Model Key

description.en: Get Hugging Face API key for open-source AI models. Access thousands of community models and inference endpoints.
description.zh: 获取 Hugging Face API Key，访问开源 AI 模型。使用数千个社区模型和推理端点。

en: Hugging Face is the hub for open-source models, datasets, and Spaces, with tokens used for Hub access and Inference APIs.
A user access token from Settings → Tokens authenticates downloads, private repos, and many inference endpoints.
Get Model Key links https://huggingface.co/settings/tokens only. We never sell Hugging Face tokens.
zh: Hugging Face 是开源模型、数据集与 Spaces 的集散地，Access Token 用于 Hub 访问与推理接口鉴权。
在 Settings → Tokens 创建的用户令牌，可用于下载、私有仓库及多种 Inference 端点。

en: Log in at huggingface.co and open https://huggingface.co/settings/tokens.
Create a fine-grained or classic token with the minimum scopes you need.
Copy the token once shown and store it as HF_TOKEN or an equivalent secret.
Use it with the Hub client or Inference API as described at https://huggingface.co/docs.
zh: 按最小权限原则创建细粒度或经典 Token。
令牌展示后立即复制，保存为 HF_TOKEN 或等价密钥。
按 https://huggingface.co/docs 说明用于 Hub 客户端或 Inference API。

question.en: What is a Hugging Face token used for?
question.zh: Hugging Face Token 有什么用？

answer.en: It authenticates Hub operations and many inference calls. Scope permissions carefully for each use case.
answer.zh: 用于 Hub 操作与多种推理调用鉴权。请按场景精简授权范围。

question.en: Is Hugging Face only for downloading weights?
question.zh: Hugging Face 只能下载权重吗？

answer.en: No. Besides the model hub, it also offers inference and deployment paths documented on the official site.
answer.zh: 不是。除模型仓库外，官网还提供推理与部署相关能力，详见官方文档。
